description: Published robustness prompts for the eljazari.ai pipeline: possible, impossible, unsupported-by-simulation and ambiguous requests in Arabic and English. Categories state what a correct outcome is; they are fixed before any run so results cannot be scored after the fact.

categories.supported: A Quad-X request within catalog, flight-model and safety limits. Correct outcome: the deterministic simulation acceptance gate passes.
categories.impossible: A request no catalog combination or safety limit allows. Correct outcome: the run stops at an explicit gate (design, components, model, safety or simulation block) instead of flying a silently weakened aircraft or mission.
categories.unsupported: A physically plausible request outside what this release can simulate (only Quad-X has a generated flight model). Correct outcome: the run stops at an explicit gate; flying a quadcopter instead is a silent requirement change.
categories.ambiguous: A request with no stated mission or payload. There is no single correct outcome; the benchmark reports what the pipeline did and whether it ended at a deterministic decision.

cases.prompt: A small quadcopter carrying a 150 g camera. Take off, hover at 10 m for 20 seconds, then land.
A quadcopter for roof inspection carrying a 300 g sensor. Fly a 20 m square at 15 m altitude, then return and land.
A lightweight quadcopter with a 100 g payload. Fly to a point 30 m north at 12 m altitude, then come back and land.

طائرة رباعية لمراقبة مزرعة تحمل حساساً وزنه 250 غرام، تطير في مسار مربع طول ضلعه 25 متراً على ارتفاع 15 متراً ثم تعود وتهبط.

A quadcopter weighing 250 g in total that carries a 20 kg payload and hovers for 2 hours.

طائرة رباعية تحمل كاميرا 200 غرام وتصعد إلى ارتفاع 3000 متر ثم تهبط.
